title: Fix Sketchpad App Tests

iterations.prompt: Get all sketchpad app tests complying. Change/refactor/extend whatever is necessary to get it working. Don't remove any functionality from the tests.
iterations.author: KinanSarak <kinan.sarak@gmail.com>

summary: Fixed all 6 sketchpad app tests. Two issues resolved: 1) Disabled parallel test execution by setting workers=1 and fullyParallel=false in playwright.config.ts to prevent race conditions. 2) Added waitForDiagramStabilization helper to wait for D3 force simulation to settle before clicking diagram nodes, preventing DOM detachment errors. All 6 tests (Home, Kit, Type, Design, Docs, Feedback) now pass in 7.6 minutes.
